instructions: Dispatch exactly one task per Jules session.
A task is ready only when every depends_on task is merged into the starting branch.
Use the prompt exactly as the session base prompt; clarifications may narrow but not broaden it.
Do not auto-merge a PR until its required checks pass.

tasks.title: Establish deterministic test and CI baseline
tasks.prompt: Execute only task J00 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md. Read AGENTS.md first. Establish the deterministic Jules test and CI baseline exactly within J00 scope, add the required tests and baseline evidence, run every required validation command, and do not begin J01 or any feature implementation.

tasks.title: Fix authenticated identity and realtime isolation
tasks.prompt: Execute only J01 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md on a branch containing merged J00. Read AGENTS.md first. Fix real authenticated identity and cross-user realtime/audit isolation, add all specified negative tests, run the exact validation, and stop without starting J02 or later work.

tasks.title: Introduce canonical market and symbol normalization
tasks.prompt: Execute only J02 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md on a branch containing merged J00. Implement the pure canonical market+symbol contract and compatibility adapters with all specified tests. Do not migrate collections or change unrelated business flows.

tasks.title: Add durable domain-task repository and state machine
tasks.prompt: Execute only J03 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md after J01 and J02 are merged. Implement the persistent domain-task model, state machine, ownership, idempotency, leases, retries, cancellation, events, indexes, and concurrency tests. Do not add a worker or feature handler.

tasks.title: Add domain worker, handler registry, and task API
tasks.prompt: Execute only J04 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md after J03 is merged. Add the explicit handler protocol/registry, durable worker lifecycle, progress/cancel/retry behavior, and owner-scoped task APIs with tests. Do not register factor, backtest, alert, or automation handlers.

tasks.prompt: Execute only J05 from docs/jules/tasks/phase-0-foundations.md after J04 is merged. Extract current manual paper-trading logic into focused services without changing public behavior, characterize behavior with tests, and do not add portfolios, campaigns, lots, or new UI.

Do not implement factors or rewrite providers.
